name: Arcanist - Variant
info: Permanently increase your maximum Hit Points or Mind Points by 5 (your choice).

data.name: Arcane Regeneration
data.description: After you `willingly dismiss` an Arcanum you are `merged` with, if you are in `Crisis`, you may have yourself and every ally present on the scene recover 【SL × 5】 Hit Points.

data.name: Bind And Summon
data.description:
You may `bind` Arcana to your soul and `summon` them later. When you encounter a new Arcanum, the Game Master will reveal what you must do in order to bind them.
You may use an action and spend 30 Mind Points to `summon` the power of one of the Arcana you have previously bound (see next page).
If you take this Skill at character creation, you begin play with one Arcanum bound to you (you may `choose it` from the sample Arcana or `create it` with your group). Any further Arcana must be obtained through exploration and story progression.

data.name: Phantom Strength
data.description: As long as you are `merged` with an Arcanum, you deal 【SL】 extra damage with `free attacks`, `pulses`, and `spells`. When you deal damage with a `pulse` or `dismiss` effect, if you have an `arcane`, `dagger`, or `flail` weapon equipped, you may have it ignore Affinities.

data.name: Quick Summoning
data.description: When you `summon` an Arcanum on your turn during a conflict, choose up to two options: reduce its Mind Point cost by 【SL × 5】; and/or after you summon the Arcanum, immediately perform its `pulse`. If you choose at least one option, you `cannot willingly dismiss` that Arcanum until the start of your next turn; if you choose both, that Arcanum's `dismiss` effect will not be available for this summoning.

data.name: Ritual Arcanism
data.description:
You may perform Rituals of the `Arcanism` discipline, as long as their effects fall within the `domains` of one or more Arcana you have bound (see next pages).
Arcanism Rituals use 【WLP + WLP】 for the Magic Check.

data.name: Arcanum
data.description:
*Merging with an Arcanum*
When you summon an Arcanum, you gain their `merge` benefits; those benefits last until the Arcanum is dismissed (see below).
You cannot summon an Arcanum while already merged with one; you must first dismiss the current Arcanum.

*Dismissing an Arcanum*
If you are merged with an Arcanum, they will be `automatically dismissed` at the end of the scene, if you die or fall unconscious, or if you leave the scene.
You may also `willingly dismiss` the Arcanum you are currently merged with: this never requires an action, but during a conflict it can only be done on your turn, while no other effect is being resolved.

*Pulses and Dismiss Effects*
In addition to their `merge` effects, the vast majority of Arcana also grant the Arcanist a `pulse` and a `dismiss` effect.

- As long as you are merged with a given Arcanum, you may use an action to unleash that Arcanum's `pulse`. You may `only` do so during a conflict scene.

- When you `willingly` dismiss an Arcanum, you may unleash their `dismiss` effect — if the Arcanum is dismissed for any other reason, this effect cannot be used. You are also free to ignore a `dismiss` effect if you don't want to use it.

- If a `pulse` or `dismiss` effect deals damage, it will deal 5 extra damage if you are `level 20 or higher`, or 10 extra damage if you are `level 40 or higher`.

Some effects follow unique rules, explained within the Arcanum's text.

*Domains*
Each Arcanum is associated with a few key concepts or `domains`. The Game Master should use these to establish the trials or conditions needed for the Arcanum to lend their power, and to adjudicate Rituals performed through the `Ritual Arcanism` Skill once that Arcanum has been bound.

data.name: Antikythera
data.info: The enigmatic custodians of time and space. Domains: space, time, void.
data.description:
*MERGE: Kaleidoscope Veil*
After you lose Hit Points due to damage, if that damage has a type and that type is not `physical`, you gain Resistance to that damage type and lose any previous Resistance granted by this effect.
When this Arcanum is `dismissed`, you lose any Resistance gained through this effect.

*PULSE: Binary Stars*
You deal 10 `fire` damage to an enemy you can see; then, you deal 10 `ice` damage to an enemy you can see (the same or a different one).

*DISMISS: Spacetime Subtraction*
Choose one option: every enemy you can see suffers `slow`; `or` every enemy you can see that is suffering from `slow` will perform one fewer action during their next turn (to a minimum of 0 actions); `or` you teleport yourself and up to five other nearby allies you can see to a location you visited in the past, provided that location is within `1 travel day` of your position.
Once the second or third option is chosen, this `dismiss` effect becomes unavailable until next dawn.

data.name: Banshee
data.info: The ominous tyrant queen of winds. Domains: birds, curses, wind.
data.description:
*MERGE: Winds of Ill Omen*
You gain Resistance to `air` damage.
When an enemy you can see that is suffering from `two or more status effects` recovers Hit Points, instead they recover `half` as many Hit Points.

*PULSE: Zephyr Blade*
You deal 20 `air` damage to an enemy you can see. An enemy who loses Hit Points due to this damage suffers `dazed`.

*DISMISS: Voidvoice*
You deal 20 `air` damage to every enemy you can see. This damage ignores Resistances, and every enemy that loses Hit Points due to it also stops being affected by all spells with a `duration` of "Scene" that were affecting them.

data.name: Caladrius
data.info: The winged master of healing magic. Domains: exorcism, healing, sunlight.
data.description:
*MERGE: Protective Gaze*
When you summon this Arcanum, choose a status effect: `dazed`, `enraged`, `poisoned`, `shaken`, `slow`, or `weak`. As long as you are merged with this Arcanum, you and every ally present on the scene are immune to the chosen status effect.

*PULSE: Cleansing Sunlight*
Choose one option: you deal 15 `light` damage to each of up to two enemies you can see; `or` one creature you can see recovers from all status effects.

*DISMISS: Healing Feathers*
You and every ally present on the scene recover 30 Hit Points. This amount increases to 40 if you are `level 20 or higher`, or to 50 if you are `level 40 or higher`.

data.name: Enkidu
data.info: The primordial beast warrior. Domains: earth, sandstorms, strength.
data.description:
*MERGE: Primordial Favor*
You gain Resistance to `earth` damage and are immune to `poisoned`.

*PULSE: Sandstorm Claws*
Choose `earth` or `physical`: you deal 15 damage of the chosen type to each of up to two enemies you can see. Then if you dealt damage to `only one` enemy this way, you gain Resistance to all damage types until the end of that enemy's next turn.

*DISMISS: Tectonic Throw*
You deal 30 `earth` damage to an enemy you can see, and that enemy cannot perform the `Guard` and `Spell` actions until the end of their next turn. This damage ignores Resistances and Immunities.

data.name: Kuzunoha
data.info: The fierce protector of witches and beasts. Domains: animals, lightning, sorcery.
data.description:
*MERGE: Mantle of the White Fox*
You gain Resistance to `bolt` damage, and can always communicate with creatures belonging to the `beast`, `monster`, or `plant` Species.
When one or more enemies you can see lose Hit Points due to `bolt` damage, you gain `1 Orb Point`. When this Arcanum is dismissed, you lose all `Orb Points`.

*PULSE: Crackling Sigil*
Choose one option: you perform a `free attack` with a weapon you have equipped; `or` you perform the `Spell` action for free, casting an `offensive` (*ϟ*) spell with a `total Mind Point cost of 10 or lower` without paying its MP cost. If this attack or spell deals damage, you may change its type to `bolt`.

*DISMISS: Roaring Thunderbolts*
You deal an amount of `bolt` damage equal to 【5 + (the amount of Orb Points you lost by dismissing this Arcanum, multiplied by 5)】 to every enemy you can see.

data.name: Moroz
data.info: The ancient father of glaciers. Domains: cold, ice, silence.
data.description:
*MERGE: Snowfall Silence*
You gain Resistance to `ice` damage and are immune to `enraged`.
After an enemy causes you to lose Hit Points with a `melee` attack, you deal 5 `ice` damage to that enemy.

*PULSE: Relentless Winter*
You deal 15 `ice` damage to each of up to two enemies you can see. If this is `not` the first time you perform this `pulse` during this scene, this damage ignores Resistances and every enemy that loses Hit Points due to it suffers `weak`.

*DISMISS: Glacier's Disdain*
You deal 20 `ice` damage to every enemy you can see. This damage ignores Resistances, and every enemy that loses Hit Points due to it also loses an amount of Mind Points equal to `half` the HP loss they suffered.

data.name: Nimue
data.info: The wielder of ninety-nine swords. Domains: conquest, heroism, leadership.
data.description:
*MERGE: Royal Armaments*
When you deal damage, you deal 5 extra damage; all damage you deal loses its type and cannot gain a type (thus being unaffected by damage Affinities).

*PULSE: Arondight*
You perform a `free attack` with a weapon you have equipped. This attack targets Magic Defense instead of Defense. If the weapon is a `sword`, the attack gains `multi (2)`.

*DISMISS: Gordian Slice*
One enemy you can see loses 30 Hit Points, or 40 Hit Points if you are `level 30 or higher`. Then, if that enemy `is not a Villain` and their current Hit Points are `equal to or lower than your Crisis score`, they are reduced to 0 Hit Points.

data.name: Ophanim
data.info: The guardian of a hundred gates. Domains: judgment, protection, sacrifice.
data.description:
*MERGE: Gentle Bastion*
When you summon this Arcanum, choose a damage type: `air`, `bolt`, `dark`, `earth`, `fire`, `ice`, or `poison`. As long as you are merged with this Arcanum, your allies present on the scene gain Resistance to the chosen type (you `do not` gain this Resistance).

*PULSE: Exorcism Bolt*
Choose one option: you deal 20 `light` damage to an enemy you can see; `or` one creature you can see stops being affected by all spells with a `duration` of "Scene" that were affecting them.

*DISMISS: Twilight of Judgment*
You deal 20 `light` damage to every enemy you can see. This damage ignores Resistances and Immunities.

data.name: Qilin
data.info: The elusive herald of wisdom and good fortune. Domains: knowledge, prosperity, temperance.
data.description:
*MERGE: Enlightened Serenity*
You treat your `Insight` as if it were one die size higher (up to a maximum of `d12`).

*PULSE: Steps of Prosperity*
Choose one option: an ally you can see treats their `Insight` as if it were one die size higher (up to a maximum of `d12`) until the start of your next turn; `or` you perform the `Spell` action for free, casting a `non-offensive` (*ϟ*) spell with a `total Mind Point cost of 10 or lower` without paying its MP cost.

*DISMISS: Oracle*
You ask the Game Master a single question. The Game Master must answer truthfully, describing the vision shown to you by this Arcanum.
Once used, this `dismiss` effect becomes unavailable until the next dawn.

data.name: Tubalcain
data.info: The blazing guardian of the forge. Domains: fire, heat, metal.
data.description:
*MERGE: Blessings of the Anvil*
You gain Resistance to `fire` damage, and `fire` damage you deal ignores Resistances.
When you deal damage, you may change its type to `fire`.

*PULSE: Forge Hammer*
Choose one option: you perform a `free attack` with a weapon you have equipped, and that attack gains `multi (2)`; `or` choose an ally you can see, and until the start of your next turn, damage dealt by that ally becomes `fire` and its type cannot change.

*DISMISS: Molten Shaper*
Choose one option: you deal 20 `fire` damage to every enemy you can see, and this damage ignores Resistances; `or` choose an item equipped by yourself or an ally you can see. Until you choose another item this way, creatures that have the item equipped gain Resistance to `fire` damage, and if the item is a weapon, it deals `fire` damage, deals 4 extra damage, and gains a +1 bonus to its Accuracy Check formula.

data.name: Vanagandr
data.info: The dark wolf of the End Times. Domains: death, despair, hunger.
data.description:
*MERGE: Shroud of Hunger*
You gain Resistance to `dark` damage, and damage you deal ignores Resistances.

*PULSE: Devourer of Men*
You deal 15 `dark` damage to each of up to two enemies you can see. This effect deals 5 extra damage against `humanoids`.

*DISMISS: Devourer of Gods*
You deal 30 `dark` damage to an enemy you can see; this damage ignores Resistances and Immunities. Then, if that enemy is in `Crisis` and lost Hit Points this way, you recover an amount of Hit Points equal to `half` the HP loss they suffered.
